steps.title: After Vamp Fatale appears
steps.rule: Go to 3m south of the centre.

steps.title: After Undead Deathmatch cast starts
steps.rule: Depends on NorthSouth: true → at A; false → at D.

OffTank.rule: Depends on NorthSouth: true → at C; false → at B.

ShieldHealer.rule: Depends on NorthSouth: true → at C; false → at B.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Depends on NorthSouth: true → at C; false → at B.

CasterDps.rule: Depends on NorthSouth: true → at C; false → at B.

steps.title: After Sanguine Scratch cast starts
steps.rule: Depends on NorthSouth: true → N 8m; false → at D.

OffTank.rule: Depends on NorthSouth: true → S 8m; false → at B.

ShieldHealer.rule: Depends on NorthSouth: true → S 8m; false → at B.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Depends on NorthSouth: true → S 8m; false → at B.

CasterDps.rule: Depends on NorthSouth: true → S 8m; false → at B.

steps.title: After Sanguine Scratch resolves
steps.rule: Depends on NorthSouth and Cycles has DeathmatchCycle { FirstConeOffset = 22.5, Spin = 1, Group1BatIsCircle = True }: true & no → at C; true & yes → S 4m; false & yes → E 4m; false & no → at B.

OffTank.rule: Depends on NorthSouth and Cycles has DeathmatchCycle { FirstConeOffset = 22.5, Spin = 1, Group1BatIsCircle = True }: true & no → N 4m; true & yes → at A; false & yes → at D; false & no → W 4m.

ShieldHealer.rule: Depends on NorthSouth and Cycles has DeathmatchCycle { FirstConeOffset = 22.5, Spin = 1, Group1BatIsCircle = True }: true & no → N 4m; true & yes → at A; false & yes → at D; false & no → W 4m.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Depends on NorthSouth and Cycles has DeathmatchCycle { FirstConeOffset = 22.5, Spin = 1, Group1BatIsCircle = True }: true & no → N 4m; true & yes → at A; false & yes → at D; false & no → W 4m.

CasterDps.rule: Depends on NorthSouth and Cycles has DeathmatchCycle { FirstConeOffset = 22.5, Spin = 1, Group1BatIsCircle = True }: true & no → N 4m; true & yes → at A; false & yes → at D; false & no → W 4m.

steps.title: After Breakdown Drop resolves
steps.rule: Go to 2m south of the centre.
